engrossed-amendment-form.current-chamber: In the Senate of the United States,

section.text: That the resolution from the House of Representatives (H.J. Res. 31) entitled Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the Department of Homeland Security for fiscal year 2019, and for other purposes., do pass with the following

amendment-instruction.text: Strike all after the enacting clause and insert the following:

section.text: The Continuing Appropriations Act, 2019 (division C of Public Law 115–245) is further amended—

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (2), by striking or at the end;

clause.text: by inserting except as provided in paragraph (4), before December; and
by striking the period at the end and inserting ; or; and

subparagraph.text: by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: with respect to appropriations and funds made available, and other authorities granted, pursuant to section 101(5) of this joint resolution for the Department of Homeland Security, February 15, 2019.
in section 110, by adding at the end the following:

subsection.text: With respect to mandatory payments whose budget authority was provided in the Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2018 (division F of Public Law 115–141), subsections (a) and (b) shall be applied by substituting section 105(4) for section 105(3) each place it appears.
